You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0040.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

# Atom list: element and approximate drawing coordinate
atoms = [

('O',956,780), #42 OH
('C',731,522), #43 macrocycle C
('C',731,405), #44 branch stereocenter
('O',783,314), #45 OH (near label OH actually coordinate approximate)
('C',820,405), #46 methyl
('C',627,343), #47 macrocycle C
('C',627,226), #48 alpha right
('C',700,180), #49 methyl
]
# Fix IDs comments (actual 45 OH,46 methyl,47,48,49)

rw=Chem.RWMol()
for el,x,y in atoms:
    a=Chem.Atom(el)
    rw.AddAtom(a)

def bond(i,j,typ=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(i,j,typ)
# macrocycle and branches
bond(0,1,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond(0,2); bond(0,48)
bond(2,3); bond(2,4); bond(4,5); bond(4,6); bond(6,7); bond(6,8); bond(6,9); bond(9,10); bond(9,11); bond(11,12); bond(12,13,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond(12,14); bond(14,15); bond(14,16); bond(16,17); bond(16,29)
bond(29,30); bond(29,31); bond(29,43); bond(43,44); bond(44,45); bond(44,46); bond(44,47); bond(47,48); bond(48,49)
# lower sugar
bond(17,18); bond(18,19); bond(19,20); bond(20,21); bond(20,22); bond(22,23); bond(22,24); bond(24,25); bond(24,26); bond(26,27); bond(24,28); bond(28,18)
# right sugar
bond(31,32); bond(32,33); bond(33,34); bond(34,35); bond(34,36); bond(36,37); bond(37,38); bond(38,39); bond(38,40); bond(37,41); bond(41,42); bond(41,32)

mol=rw.GetMol()
# valence/sanitize
Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
conf=Chem.Conformer(mol.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(_,x,y) in enumerate(atoms): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(float(x),float(-y),0.0))
mol.AddConformer(conf)
# Set stereochemical wedge directions. bond begins at stereocenter.
wedges={
(2,3):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,
(48,49):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(4,5):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,
(6,7):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,
(6,8):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(9,10):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(14,15):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,
(16,17):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(18,17):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(24,25):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,
(24,26):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(22,23):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(20,21):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,
(29,30):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(29,31):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(32,31):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(34,35):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(37,38):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(41,42):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,
(44,45):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,
(44,46):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
}
for (i,j),d in wedges.items():
 b=mol.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j)
 if b is None: raise Exception((i,j))
 # assure specified begin atom center, b's initial atom should be i by creation order often not. Bond dir points from begin atom; orient bond accordingly impossible after graph; set begin/end by swapping via reverse? Set direction sign must account orientation.
 if b.GetBeginAtomIdx()==i: b.SetBondDir(d)
 else:
  # inverse wedge direction when center is end
  inv={Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE:Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE, Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH:Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH}
  # rdkit direction is encoded relative to bond begin, wedge narrows at begin, so if center is end invert wedge/dash
  inv={Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE:Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH, Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH:Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE}
  b.SetBondDir(inv[d])

Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(mol, confId=0, replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('initial tags')
for a in mol.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:
  print(a.GetIdx(), atoms[a.GetIdx()][0],a.GetChiralTag(), a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-')
print('smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(mol))
# add explicit Hs, retain chirality
mol=Chem.AddHs(mol, addCoords=True)
# use ETKDG
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=84041; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True; params.useMacrocycle14config=True
params.maxIterations=1000
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol,params)
print('embed status',status,'atoms',mol.GetNumAtoms())
if status<0:
 raise SystemExit('embedding failed')
# MMFF minimize
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mol)
print('MMFF?',props is not None)
if props:
 ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mol,props,ignoreInterfragInteractions=False)
 ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('final stereo')
for a in mol.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:
  print(a.GetIdx(), a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-', a.GetChiralTag())
# output xyz
conf=mol.GetConformer()
with open('/root/answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{mol.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated from mol_0040.png; RDKit ETKDG/MMFF\n')
 for i,a in enumerate(mol.GetAtoms()):
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .6f} {p.y: .6f} {p.z: .6f}\n')
PY

def bond(a,b,order=1): rw.AddBond(idx[a],idx[b],{1:Chem.BondType.SINGLE,2:Chem.BondType.DOUBLE,3:Chem.BondType.TRIPLE}[order])

from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

spec=[
('C',523,167),('O',523,50),('C',420,226),('C',318,167),('C',420,343),('O',523,405),
('C',318,405),('O',271,343),('C',214,405),('C',318,522),('C',214,583),('O',420,583),

('C',627,1063),('C',523,1145),('O',523,1063),('C',420,1090),('C',627,941),('C',627,583),
('C',523,522),('O',834,583),('C',956,583),('O',1016,480),('C',1134,480),('C',1196,405),
('C',1196,583),('C',1134,685),('N',1195,770),('C',1280,740),('C',1280,820),('C',1016,685),
('O',956,780),('C',731,522),('C',731,405),('O',783,314),('C',820,405),('C',627,343),('C',627,226),('C',700,180)]
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for el,x,y in spec: rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el))
def b(i,j,order=1): rw.AddBond(i,j,{1:Chem.BondType.SINGLE,2:Chem.BondType.DOUBLE}[order])
# Core lactone/macrolide
for i,j,o in [(0,1,2),(0,2,1),(0,48,1),(2,3,1),(2,4,1),(4,5,1),(4,6,1),(6,7,1),(6,8,1),(6,9,1),(9,10,1),(9,11,1),(11,12,1),(12,13,2),(12,14,1),(14,15,1),(14,16,1),(16,17,1),(16,29,1),(29,30,1),(29,31,1),(29,43,1),(43,44,1),(44,45,1),(44,46,1),(44,47,1),(47,48,1),(48,49,1)]: b(i,j,o)
# Lower deoxy sugar
for i,j in [(17,18),(18,19),(19,20),(20,21),(20,22),(22,23),(22,24),(24,25),(24,26),(26,27),(24,28),(28,18)]: b(i,j)
# Right amino sugar
for i,j in [(31,32),(32,33),(33,34),(34,35),(34,36),(36,37),(37,38),(38,39),(38,40),(37,41),(41,42),(41,32)]: b(i,j)
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(_,x,y) in enumerate(spec): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(float(x),float(-y),0.0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
# Stereobonds: solid wedge / hashed wedge as depicted; the first atom is the stereocenter.
wedges={
(2,3):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,(48,49):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,(4,5):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,
(6,7):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,(6,8):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,(9,10):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(14,15):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,(16,17):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,(18,17):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(20,21):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,(22,23):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,(24,25):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,
(24,26):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,(29,30):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,(29,31):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(32,31):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,(34,35):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,(37,38):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,
(41,42):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,(44,45):Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE,(44,46):Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH}
def setdir(center,other,d):
 bond=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(center,other)
 # Direction labels are relative to bond's begin atom; reverse if needed.
 if bond.GetBeginAtomIdx()==center: bond.SetBondDir(d)
 else: bond.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH if d==Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE else Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
for (i,j),d in wedges.items(): setdir(i,j,d)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
# Restore two anomeric configurations separately: both neighboring glycosidic O atoms
# also carry wedges for the core stereocenters, so temporarily isolate their bond direction.
for center,other in [(18,17),(32,31)]:
 for bond in m.GetBonds():
  if bond.GetBondDir()!=Chem.BondDir.NONE and center not in (bond.GetBeginAtomIdx(),bond.GetEndAtomIdx()): bond.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.NONE)
 # Keep only the stereobond of the center being assigned.
 for bond in m.GetBonds():
  if bond.GetBondDir()!=Chem.BondDir.NONE and not {bond.GetBeginAtomIdx(),bond.GetEndAtomIdx()}=={center,other}: bond.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.NONE)
 setdir(center,other,wedges[(center,other)])
 Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
 # reapply all wedges for remaining atoms (tags already recorded)
 for (i,j),d in wedges.items(): setdir(i,j,d)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
expected=[2,4,6,9,14,16,18,20,22,24,29,32,34,37,41,44,48]
print('stereocenters:',[(i,m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode') if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).HasProp('_CIPCode') else 'unassigned') for i in expected])
missing=[i for i in expected if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetChiralTag()==Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED]
if missing: raise RuntimeError('unassigned stereocenters '+str(missing))
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=471109; p.useMacrocycleTorsions=True; p.useMacrocycle14config=True; p.maxIterations=1000
ret=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)
if ret<0: raise RuntimeError('ETKDG embedding failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props: AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,mmffVariant='MMFF94s',maxIters=1200)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('formula',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),'atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
# xyz export
c=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nMolecular structure generated from mol_0040.png\n')
 for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
  q=c.GetAtomPosition(i)
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {q.x: .6f} {q.y: .6f} {q.z: .6f}\n')
print('wrote answer.xyz')
